rationale: Every D001-D113 dependency and C01-C12 check was inspected in order against Definition 2.5.6, the four immediately preceding printed-page-27 displays, and the following minimality sentence. On positive gauge, the converse part faithfully formalizes 'smallest up to absolute constant factors': a normalized sufficient scale K for any one display must satisfy ||X||_psi2 <= C K, with source coefficients absorbed into K, and one global non-sharp C can dominate the finitely many per-display factors. The forward conjunct is stronger than the source because it fixes numerical witnesses that the source leaves unspecified. More importantly, the universal theorem includes gauge zero and thereby gives Lean-totalized meanings to quotient-bearing displays for which the source states no convention. That unresolved boundary affects Lean-implies-source for the combined target, so the overall classification is undetermined and adjudication is required; if a compatible zero-gauge convention is accepted, the positive-gauge analysis supports faithful-stronger rather than faithful-equivalent.
